verdicts.reasoning: I traced the path end to end. canvas-panel.tsx:1243-1255 appends `{version, content: "", origin: "edit"}` and calls onArtifactUpdated. chat-view.tsx:1254-1263 writes that into chat.artifacts. The effect at canvas-panel.tsx:313-315 then sets selectedVersion to the new currentVersion. versionContent at canvas-panel.tsx:369-370 comes out as "", because `?? artifact.content` does not catch an empty string. The wrapper keyed by selectedVersion (1237) remounts DesignEditor. useDesignDocument's effect (use-design-document.ts:170-189) parses "", parseStoredDesignDocument throws 'Design document is not valid JSON' (migrations.ts:91-97), and design-editor.tsx:520-531 shows 'This design can't be opened'. The first user edit always reaches this path: allocatesCheckpoint (operations.ts:529-539) returns true whenever the latest row's origin is not 'edit', so generated output is never folded. store.ts:122-126 then calls appendVersion, httpTransport returns the bumped currentVersion (use-design-document.ts:104), and onCommitted fires (276). A folded edit returns the same version and is ignored by the `<=` guard, so the bug triggers on the first new checkpoint. git show 7c344b96 contains the same code (lines 296, 1034, 1049), and blame on HEAD points to 983dc2ad9 only because that commit re-touched the block. Copy, Download and History all read the same "" content. Also, `...artifact` keeps the old v1 `content`, so the transcript card stays stale after edits.

A tsx probe of splitMessageContent on a closed tag returned `{type:'artifact', identifier:'t'}` with no content or streaming flag (message-content.ts:256-261). message-item.tsx:1366-1373 passes `streaming={part.streaming && message.streaming}`, which is false, and `content={artifact?.content ?? part.content}`, which is undefined for a new identifier. use-chat.ts handles only activity, approval, sources, work, reasoning and delta frames before `done`, and mergeArtifacts runs only in `done` (use-chat.ts:678) or in recovery. The server sends `done` only after persistAssistantTurn, persistArtifacts, memory writes and the activity update (route.ts:3095-3185). For that whole window artifact-inline-card.tsx:441-454 renders the tone=error 'Source unavailable' EmptyState.

message-item.tsx:1369-1372 prefers the persisted artifact for title, type and content. On a same-identifier rewrite, artifactsByIdentifier already holds the previous version, so part.content (the live stream from OPEN_ARTIFACT_RE, message-content.ts:268-279) is never shown. streaming is true, so the header reads 'Writing' with the gen-sweep, and the view is forced to 'code' (artifact-inline-card.tsx:196-202), where CodeSurface shows the old source. This applies to normal full rewrites. Modify/artifactEdit turns send no deltas at all (route.ts:3016).

runtimeFor('DESIGN') returns mode 'design' (artifact-runtime.ts:98). The inline card sets inlinePreview = hasContent && mode !== 'none', which is true (artifact-inline-card.tsx:181), and the view defaults to 'preview'. RuntimePreview special-cases only MARKDOWN (inline-card:125-131). buildSandboxDoc (sandbox-frame.tsx:787-803) has no 'design' case and falls through to an escaped <pre> wrapped with statusLite=true, so the status reads 'Live'. The system prompt steers 'design/mock up a screen' requests to DESIGN (system-prompt.ts:269). Because the Canvas never auto-opens (ux-0), this JSON sheet is what users see by default.

design-editor.tsx:549-550 keys the embedded rails to viewport md/lg, and the doc comment at 187-196 confirms this is deliberate and keyed to the viewport. Rails are shrink-0 with inline widths from PANE_BOUNDS, 208 and 256 initially (panel-layout.tsx:37-38). The centre column is `min-w-0 flex-1` (design-editor.tsx:~771), so it collapses to about 0. The canvas default is 46% of the container (chat-view.tsx:1150) with a 420 minimum (split-layout.ts:30). At 1280px with a 256-304px sidebar, the canvas is about 449-471px, against 464px of rails. tests/split-layout.test.ts:69-80 checks only chat-view, thought-process-panel and canvas-panel. CanvasPanel does not pass `surface`, so it gets the default 'embedded'. Stored pane sizes or collapse state in localStorage can change the exact numbers.

chat-view.tsx:969 is a plain arrow function recreated on every render. It is passed at 2272 and forwarded as-is at message-list.tsx:353 to every memoised MessageItem (message-item.tsx:788), whose doc comment (762-786) says every handler must be stable. It is worse than the auditor states: `handleSpeak` (chat-view.tsx:1503) is also a plain function, passed at 2279 and forwarded at message-list.tsx:363. Memoising onOpenArtifact alone will not restore the bail-out (see missed item).

chat-view.tsx:2503-2506 drops the `animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-right-4` classes while canvas.resizing is true. use-split-pane.ts:414 sets it true on pointerdown and :368 sets it false in stop(). Re-adding animation-name restarts the enter animation, so the panel replays its entrance after every release, and even after a plain click on the grip. The thought dock avoids this with animateDock (chat-view.tsx:1176-1182, 2440-2450). The file-viewer wrapper at 2548-2553 has the same pattern.

The exit branch at chat-view.tsx:2506 (and 2553 for files) is an unconditional `animate-out fade-out slide-out-to-right-4`. The comment at 2483-2486 says the tailwindcss-animate translate cannot be reached by --motion-shift. globals.css reduced-motion blocks (874-886, 3510-3519, 3746-3792) have no rule neutralising the exit translate or `.animate-out`. ICONS_AND_MOTION.md:223-225 (§2.2 item 10) requires travel to collapse under reduced motion.

The draft is local state (canvas-panel.tsx:252-254). openAttachment (chat-view.tsx:1020-1032) sets openArtifactId and closingArtifact to null, which unmounts CanvasPanel at once. closeArtifact (951-955) and openVoice (1570-1572) also close it, and the artifact.id effect (canvas-panel.tsx:296-311) clears the draft. `dirty` (525) is used only for the save bar and the selection gate, and neither file has a beforeunload handler or confirm. grep found no session or local storage persistence of the draft.

canInspect (canvas-panel.tsx:707) and captureSelection (570-602) do not check isLatest. handleElementSelected and quoteSelection send `baseVersion: selectedVersion` (668, 717). For mode 'modify', composer.tsx:802-807 turns this into artifactEditRequestFromQuote (quote-context.ts:91-101). route.ts:1469-1473 answers 409 'This canvas changed after you made the selection' when baseVersion is not currentVersion. The code-selection path, by contrast, is gated on isLatest (canvas-panel.tsx:1356). Old versions are reachable through 'View vN' (1231). The Markdown preview selection path has the same gap.

The toolbar is portalled to the end of body (canvas-panel.tsx:1393-1420). No shortcut calls quoteSelection (grep finds only the two onClick handlers), and there is no focus hand-off. In CodeSurface, Tab indents (code-surface.tsx:256-265), Escape clears and blurs (266-273), and blur clears the bar (342). For a Markdown preview selection, the bar sits at the very end of the tab order, and the non-focusable container needs caret browsing to select anything. There is no practical keyboard path.

openArtifactByIdentifier (chat-view.tsx:969-993) only sets state. Below the split, the chat column that holds the focused Open button becomes `hidden` (1996-2000), so focus is lost. canvas-panel.tsx has no focus() or autoFocus call, and its only tabIndex is on the diff region (1052). Fullscreen sets role=dialog and aria-modal (786-788) with no FocusScope or inert on the chat, and grep finds inert only on composer sub-parts (chat-view.tsx:2350-2395). Closing does not return focus to the card.

Console mode makes inlinePreview true, and the view defaults to preview (artifact-inline-card.tsx:181, 185, 196-202). The iframe is created eagerly with srcDoc (sandbox-frame.tsx:849-931), with no loading=lazy, IntersectionObserver or virtualisation (grep over message-list, card and sandbox). consoleDoc evals JS at load (699-714) or boots Pyodide from jsdelivr (637-697). SANDBOX_ALLOW includes allow-modals (85-86). The share viewer deliberately does not run console runtimes (shared-artifact-viewer.tsx:31-32). One overstatement: files a script 'writes' go only to Pyodide's in-memory FS and are offered as download links, so nothing reaches the user's disk.

message-item.tsx:1370-1375 uses artifact.content, artifact.currentVersion and an identifier-based onOpen for every message, and the Canvas selects currentVersion (canvas-panel.tsx:313-315). ArtifactVersion has no messageId (schema.prisma:1146-1160). Correction: the mapping is recoverable. The persisted message text keeps each turn's (verified or repaired) artifact body, via rewriteArtifactMarkup at route.ts:447, but splitMessageContent throws the body of closed tags away (message-content.ts:256-261).

The default branch of runtimeFor returns mode 'console' with engine 'unsupported' (artifact-runtime.ts:124-125), and nothing ever returns 'none'. So inlinePreview is true and the card and Canvas default to Output (artifact-inline-card.tsx:181-185; canvas-panel.tsx:246). consoleDoc prints the 'not available' warning and posts status('done','Ready') (sandbox-frame.tsx:632-636), which the card labels 'Done' for console mode (artifact-inline-card.tsx:230-231). No test pins this as intended.

__JunoLucideShapes holds 17 named icons plus a default (sandbox-frame.tsx:188-207), and unknown names fall back to default (225). stripImports removes every import (129-134). The sandbox loads only React, ReactDOM and Babel from unpkg (8-10) and has no recharts, framer-motion or shadcn (grep). The system prompt says 'no imports needed beyond react' (system-prompt.ts:258).

LINK_BRIDGE (sandbox-frame.tsx:293-310) resolves a.href, which the DOM has already made absolute, and forwards any http(s) URL. The parent then calls window.open (878-896). Inferred from the HTML spec: the fallback base URL of an about:srcdoc document is its container or initiator document's URL, so '/about' resolves to the Juno origin. base-uri 'none' (67) blocks the author's <base> fix. This is spec-based and not observed at runtime, but it is well established.

createShare returns the newest unrevoked share (share.ts:91-95), and snapshotAt is set only on create (104). getSharedArtifactSnapshot serves the version with createdAt ≤ snapshotAt (257-265). The dialog creates or reuses the link on open (share-dialog.tsx:77-85) and says 'as it is now' (120-122). One evidence error: the dialog does show the snapshot date ('Snapshot · {date}', share-dialog.tsx:189-191), and Revoke then 'Create a new link' produces a fresh snapshot. That partly mitigates the bug, hence low. The copy is still wrong for a reused link, and there is no in-place refresh.

rewriteVersion changes only `content` (store.ts:179-190), so createdAt stays. Folding applies to user 'edit' rows younger than 30s (operations.ts:511, 529-539). The share snapshot selects by createdAt ≤ snapshotAt (share.ts:257-260), so post-share folded edits appear on the public link. In practice they appear as raw JSON, because the share viewer does not render DESIGN (see missed item).

I reproduced it with a tsx probe. Quoting the text '"""
A calculator module.
"""
import math
x = 1' through serializeQuote → parseQuotedMessage returns text '' and a request containing the code plus 'Explain'. readFence closes on the first line equal to """ (quote-context.ts:256-262), and serializeQuote (208-227) does not escape the text.
canvas-panel.tsx:461-465 swallows the writeText rejection and then flashes success and 'Source copied.'. copyDiff (412-417) and ShareDialog.copy (share-dialog.tsx:88-93) do the same.

onPointerDown sets state on the step items, flow nodes and quiz options (inline-visual-block.tsx:271, 323, 446). A touch pointerdown fires before the browser decides to pan. Correction: the quiz does not lock. QuizBlock has no disabled or answered guard (426-436), so the user can reselect. The impact is premature 'Correct.'/'Not quite.' feedback and a revealed explanation, not a locked answer.

The server deletes artifacts whose messageId is the regenerated message (route.ts:2573), and mergeArtifacts only upserts (use-chat.ts:344-354). Mitigation the auditor missed: DB triggers record Artifact and Message changes (migration 20260716200000:113-117). AppProvider's sync EventSource calls router.refresh (app-provider.tsx:184-203), and use-chat reconciles `setArtifacts(opts.initialArtifacts)` when the transcript JSON changes and status is idle (use-chat.ts:318-335). That removes the stale row within about 2s for conversations opened by route. The refresh is deferred while on a soft route (app-provider.tsx:197-200; chat-view sets __junoSoftRoutePath for chats started in this page, 369/408/441/1673). So the bug persists in the common 'new chat → regenerate' flow, or when sync is disconnected.

setOpenArtifactId is called only from the user open path (chat-view.tsx:976), the ?artifact deep link (915), handleArtifactUpdated when the canvas is already open (1262), and close/reset paths. Nothing opens the canvas on creation or streams into it. The card is a fixed `h-[min(44vh,360px)] min-h-[240px]` scroll box (artifact-inline-card.tsx:378). The system prompt forbids mentioning panels (system-prompt.ts:247). This is an accurate UX observation; severity is a product judgement.

setSelectedVersion is called only at canvas-panel.tsx:314 (the sync effect), 1142 (back-to-latest pill) and 1231 (failure 'View vN'). Version rows call selectTarget (989 → 407-410), which sets only compareTarget and compareBase for the diff. The only other way to see an old version rendered is Restore (1097-1103), which writes a new version.

serializeDesignDocument emits single-line JSON (migrations.ts:111-113). The Canvas History view diffs whole lines (canvas-panel.tsx:388-391, 1057-1089) and is not gated off for DESIGN (802, 893). A design diff is therefore one removed line and one added line, and with the defect-1 synthetic rows it compares against "". The embedded editor does have its own 'History' rail (design-editor.tsx:723, 760: HistoryList), but it lists the in-session undo history, not stored versions. Neither offers a visual comparison.

The failure banner (canvas-panel.tsx:1223-1235) offers only Console (web mode) and 'View v{lastGood}'. grep for fix or 'ask juno' in canvas-panel and the inline card finds nothing, and there is no action that seeds the composer with the error.

canvas-panel.tsx has no streaming or busy input (grep finds no 'streaming', 'busy' or 'writing'). It follows chat.artifacts, which changes only on `done`, then swaps versions with a fade (313-315 and keyed containers). For Modify, route.ts:3016 withholds all deltas, and the progress activity ('Preparing targeted changes', 3006-3011) appears only in the transcript's activity log.

missed.title: handleSpeak is also a non-memoized handler passed to every MessageItem, so fixing onOpenArtifact alone will not restore the memo
missed.evidence: `const handleSpeak = (id: string, text: string) => {…}` is a plain function (chat-view.tsx:1503-1511). It is passed as `onSpeak={handleSpeak}` (2279) and forwarded unchanged to each row (message-list.tsx:363). MessageItem's memo requires every handler to be a useCallback (message-item.tsx:778-779).
missed.failure_scenario: Even after openArtifactByIdentifier is wrapped in useCallback, every stream chunk still gives MessageItem a new onSpeak identity. All rows in a long transcript keep re-rendering 30-60 times a second.

missed.title: Tab with a selection in the Canvas code editor deletes the selected text instead of indenting it, with no native undo
missed.evidence: On plain Tab the handler builds `ta.value.slice(0, selectionStart) + "  " + ta.value.slice(selectionEnd)` and calls onChange(next) (code-surface.tsx:256-265). A multi-line selection is therefore replaced by two spaces. The value is set programmatically through React state (canvas-panel.tsx:1354 handleDraftChange), which bypasses the textarea's native undo stack. code-surface.tsx has no undo handling (grep for undo, execCommand and insertText finds nothing).
missed.failure_scenario: On the latest version, select lines 10-20 in the Code tab and press Tab to indent them. The eleven lines vanish and two spaces take their place. Cmd+Z does not bring them back. The only recovery is Discard, which also throws away every other unsaved edit.

missed.title: Shared DESIGN artifacts render as raw JSON source on the public share page
missed.evidence: `const hasPreview = isMarkdown || rt.mode === "web"` (shared-artifact-viewer.tsx:32). runtimeFor('DESIGN') returns mode 'design' (artifact-runtime.ts:98), so the page opens on the Code tab with no Preview trigger (33, 50). The share page has no DESIGN branch (src/app/share/[token]/page.tsx:8, 90).
missed.failure_scenario: Share a chat-made sign-in screen design from the Canvas and send the link. The recipient sees minified document JSON, not the design. This blocks the 'typed artifacts at one shareable link' goal of the Artifacts+Design merge.

missed.title: React and TypeScript previews load an unpinned @babel/standalone and React development builds from unpkg
missed.evidence: BABEL_CDN = "https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone/babel.min.js" has no version (sandbox-frame.tsx:10), while React is pinned but uses react.development.js and react-dom.development.js (8-9). Every React card and Canvas preview loads these (513-515).
missed.failure_scenario: A new major release of @babel/standalone with changed preset behaviour (for example availablePresets or the TypeScript preset options used at sandbox-frame.tsx:712) silently breaks every REACT and TS artifact preview for all users at once, with no code change in Juno. Development builds also slow every inline preview.
